text:
morgan: Heads-up — we're planning a short rollout to backfill a routing capacity tag into client SDK requests so the router can do 'capacity-swap' when Dedicated pools are saturated. This is a header-only change (x-rd-capacity) but could surface as a breaking behavior in old SDKs if they validate allowed headers. Want to coordinate the SDK changes + console mapping.
alex: Can you paste the header format? quick example pls
morgan: Sure. Plan is simple: add header `x-rd-capacity: reserved=high,spill=best-effort` or `x-rd-capacity: mode=reserved,level=high`. Router will parse either (we'll accept legacy comma format for 6 weeks).
jasmin: Will this affect quota attribution in the console? We need per-capacity-line metrics so customers can see reserved vs spill costs.
morgan: Good call. We'll emit telemetry event `route.capacity_hint` with {mode, level, inferred_from_sdk:true/false}. Console will map that onto the per-route dashboard as a breakdown.
sam: DevRuntime question — if an SDK doesn't send anything we currently infer mode=best-effort. If we start backfilling we might change the inferred default for some clients. Is this a behavioral change for users not pinned to model variants?
leo: We should avoid changing default behavior. Proposal: SDK backfill is opt-in via env var for 1 week canary, then auto-enable but router defaults remain unchanged unless customer flips a console switch. That keeps runtime predictable.
zach: For compatibility, can we namespace header e.g. `x-rd-capacity-v2` and have the router accept both? That reduces risk of old proxies choking on unknown values.
morgan: Router will accept both but we'd prefer a single header to avoid proliferation. The issue isn't proxies — it's SDKs that do aggressive header whitelisting (looking at you, some internal proxies). We can include fallback parsing rules and provide a small shim in the SDKs.
alex: SDK surface plan (short):
- Python: add optional param `capacity_hint` to client constructor and env var `RD_CAPACITY_HINT`.
- TS: same plus automatic header if env var set.
- Go: flag in NewClient opts and a compatibility flag `AllowUnknownHeaders` default true during rollout.
Include snippet:
```python
# python example
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv('RD_KEY'), capacity_hint='mode=reserved;level=high')
# sends header: x-rd-capacity: mode=reserved;level=high
```
jasmin: About telemetry sampling: please tag these events with low-cardinality keys. We want breakdown by tenant, mode, and level but avoid exploding time-series.
sam: We'll emit counts with `mode:{reserved,spill,best-effort}` and `level:{low,med,high}` and use reservoir sampling for examples.
leo: Rollout plan suggestion:
- Week 0: SDKs ship with env var + opt-in. Console UI: add a toggle "Enable capacity hints" per-project (off by default).
- Week 1: Enable auto-backfill for internal canary tenants, telemetry check for anomalies.
- Week 2: Gradual enable for 5% of orgs, monitor token cost delta and latency.
- Week 4: Global enable but honor per-project console toggle.
zach: Who owns the console mapping? I can make the tile but need the telemetry schema from sam.
morgan: Sam will post schema in the console ticket. Zach, add a new time-series panel: "Capacity hint split" and a table for cost delta by mode.
alex: Any docs changes? We should add a migration note in SDK CHANGES and product docs plus a short FAQ about why customers might see cost changes.
deploy-bot: deploy/signal: canary feature-flag toggles created for eng-platform:feature/capacity-backfill at 2026-02-12T09:10Z
morgan: Also flagging one edge-case: customers using strict request signing that include headers in the signature — adding header will break signatures. We'll need a migration knob and a guide recommending putting capacity hint into body metadata instead for those cases.
jasmin: Let's draft an internal migration doc listing: header vs body metadata tradeoffs, telemetry implications, console toggle flows.
leo: I'll coordinate a short cross-team sync Thursday 10am PT to review telemetry dashboards and canary metrics.
morgan: Perfect. Action items:
- sam: telemetry schema + sampling plan (today)
- alex/leo: SDK changes + opt-in env (this sprint)
- zach: console tile PR (after schema)
- jasmin: migration doc + FAQ
- morgan: rollout RFC + canary list
I'll post the RFC in #eng-platform when done. Any objections? :eyes: 
alex: no objections, just add a note about header casing (some proxies expect lowercase) — normalize to lowercase when sending.
zach: ack
sam: ack, will include casing normalization and signature caveat.
morgan: thanks all — closing thread for now, will update RFC link in a follow-up.
